designationHistory.indexText: Congress declared the reclaimed Anacostia River flats part of the District of Columbia park system and named them Anacostia Park.

authority.citation: Act of Aug. 31, 1918, ch. 164 (Public No. 208, 65th Cong.), 40 Stat. 918, 950

designationHistory.note: The designation is a proviso in an appropriations act, not a stand-alone park law.

sources.name: District of Columbia appropriations act, Aug. 31, 1918, 40 Stat. 918 (Anacostia Park proviso at p. 950) (govinfo)
D.C. Code sec. 10-155, Anacostia Park (D.C. Council)

designationHistory.indexText: Executive Order 6166 moved the parks of the National Capital, including Anacostia Park, to the Interior Department's national park office.
designationHistory.note: The order was signed June 10, 1933 and took effect 61 days later (Aug. 10). It applied to all National Capital parks, not Anacostia alone.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016, National Capital Parks-East (p. 43)
